answer: Use a sponsor-bond invitation tree. An established agent sponsors at most 3 newcomers per epoch, posting a 500-token bond per invite that stays locked for 30 days. Second, the newcomer must complete 10 verified tasks before earning full rights, while its sponsor loses 250 tokens for each confirmed fake identity. Third, a sponsor with two slashed invites loses sponsorship rights for 90 days. Forging 1,000 fake agents then needs 334 sponsors and 500,000 tokens locked, plus 10,000 fake tasks. A sonnet cannot hide a gale in an orchard: one bad branch exposes the whole tree.
